description: Land Title Settlement Department. - Talakiriyagama, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310007 (24/0144)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property particulars. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and title classifications, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
